name: Prismatic Wall

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a wall up to 90 feet long and 30 feet high, or a globe up to 30 feet across

summary: A seven-layered wall of light (up to 90 by 30 feet) or globe (up to 30 feet across); each layer punishes anyone passing through.
text: It sheds Bright Light 100 feet and Dim Light 100 more, and other creatures that come within 20 feet or start a turn there make a Con save or are Blinded for 1 minute. Passing through means a save per layer: red, orange, yellow, green and blue deal 12d6 Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison and Cold (Dex save, half on a success), indigo Restrains on a failed Con save and can Petrify after three failures, and violet Blinds on a failed Wis save and can banish to another plane. Each layer falls only to its own counter (25 Cold, strong wind, 60 Force, Passwall, 25 Fire, Daylight, Dispel Magic) in order, red first.
